help.title: How the calculator works
help.intro: We count every possible way to draw your chosen number of cards from a shuffled deck, without replacement. The result is the share of hands that meet your requirements.
help.deckBody: Add the cards or groups you care about. Remaining cards become “Other cards” automatically. Each physical copy belongs to one row.
help.openingBody: All requirements inside an option must hold together (AND). Alternative options use OR: a hand meeting either option succeeds, and is counted only once.
help.flexibleBody: By default, each flexible copy fills exactly one selected role. The calculator checks whether any valid assignment satisfies the opening. You can explicitly switch to counting each copy toward every role. Upper limits apply to the resulting role counts.
help.assumptionsBody: Cards are drawn uniformly from a shuffled deck. Roles and conditional effects are assumed available. This measures draw consistency; it does not simulate card effects, searches, sequencing, or opponent actions. The 6-card preset measures cards seen after the first draw.
help.storageBody: Edits are saved in this browser. Sharing copies your deck and scenarios into a link. Export creates a JSON backup that you can import later. No account is needed.
help.footnote: Exact combinatorial counts are used. Large scenarios have a calculation limit to keep the app responsive; an explicit message appears instead of an estimate.
